pages.title: Lumina Paths — Connect Puzzle
pages.creator: NAbber Games
pages.description: Connect equal-colored dots in Lumina Paths — Connect Puzzle without crossing or overlapping lines. Plan where the longer routes need to pass before filling the smaller gaps. Progress from five-by-five boards to eleven-by-eleven grids across 125 levels, with daily quests and achievements to work toward.

pages.title: Arrowtix - Train Your Brain
pages.creator: ZazGames
pages.description: Slide tangled arrows off the board in Arrowtix - Train Your Brain. An arrow can leave only in the direction it points and only when the route is empty. Clear pieces that unblock others as you work through sixty layouts across three difficulty settings.

pages.title: Obby Champions
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Explore different zones and build up your fighter in Obby Champions. Break through challenges, confront titans and look for rare pets with their own abilities. Collect story fragments and discover hidden codes as you develop a stronger character.

pages.title: Darts Jam
pages.creator: HeiTie
pages.description: Release colored darts into matching balloons in Darts Jam. Clear the darts from a board to make it drop, then continue with the remaining boards. Check which colors you can reach so you can bring the whole arrangement down.

pages.title: Toilet Time
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Work through a collection of bathroom-themed puzzles in Toilet Time. Inspect each unusual scene and choose what to interact with to complete its task. Try the different minigames as everyday situations turn into short comic challenges.

pages.title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Draw a bridge over the gaps in Draw Bridge Puzzle to bring a bike to its destination. You have one line to create the route, so judge the support it needs before drawing. Coordinate the path carefully when multiple vehicles share the level.

pages.title: Soccer Arena X
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Take part in quick football matches in Soccer Arena X. Build possession, defend your net and use the coins or gems you earn to unlock abilities. Try powers such as freezing or lightning when they can change the next contest.

pages.title: Teacher Simulator
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Take charge of a class in Teacher Simulator. Mark exam papers, respond to classroom problems and watch the students' behavior. Use the mouse or touch controls to carry out the day's tasks as you get used to being the teacher.

pages.title: Granny Returns 3D : Evil Destiny
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search a haunted mansion for an escape in Granny Returns 3D : Evil Destiny. Find keys and solve puzzles while keeping your movements quiet. Watch for Granny as you open the way through the rooms and look for a safe exit.

pages.title: Blackriver Mystery. Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Investigate a ruined town in Blackriver Mystery. Hidden Objects. Search scenes for requested items, complete quests and build collections as you uncover the mystery. Try the accompanying minigames while helping restore the town.

pages.title: Fishing Life
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Choose a fish and click to reel it in in Fishing Life. Upgrade strength and other fishing stats, then try equipment and assistants that improve the rewards from your catches. Watch the fish's energy as you work to bring it ashore.

pages.title: Samurai vs Yakuza - Beat Em Up
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Fight to recover occupied places in Samurai vs Yakuza - Beat Em Up. Use your samurai's attacks and collect swords or other weapons from boxes. Move through different locations and defeat the groups standing between you and the hidden treasures.

pages.title: Crazy Zoo Swipe - Match 3 Puzzle Game
pages.creator: CrazyFire
pages.description: Link identical animals in Crazy Zoo Swipe - Match 3 Puzzle Game. Make longer chains to create powerful items, then use them when a difficult board needs more clearing power. Focus on the current level's goal as you choose the next group.

pages.title: Drag Race 3D
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Race a single opponent down a straight track in Drag Race 3D. Get your timing right to carry more speed to the finish, then spend winnings on tuning the car. Return to the strip to test the effect of each upgrade.

pages.title: Balls Lover Puzzle
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Draw lines or shapes to bring two cat balls together in Balls Lover Puzzle. Look at how the drawing will fall or support them before releasing it into the scene. Complete the level by getting the pair to touch.

pages.title: Instadiva Nikke Dress Up Tutorial
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Style Nikki for a photo session in Instadiva Nikke Dress Up Tutorial. Choose hair, eyes and lashes before building an outfit from tops, trousers, jeans or skirts. Add shoes and finish the look she will wear in front of the camera.

pages.title: Sheriff Shoot
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Help an unsteady lawman hit his bottle targets in Sheriff Shoot. Watch the direction of the wobbling gun and fire when it lines up. Use each result to judge the timing of the next shot.

pages.title: Phone Transform
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a handset through the years in Phone Transform. Choose green plus gates to upgrade it and steer around obstacles that send the design backward. Watch both the next gate and the hazards as the phone travels along the course.

pages.title: INVERSION
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Switch between black and white in INVERSION to get through its two-tone platforming stages. Change the character's shade when the terrain requires it, then time the next jump around the level's hazards. Combine careful movement with well-timed inversions to advance.

pages.title: Hair Shuffle
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Move hair between two runners in Hair Shuffle while guiding them past obstacles. Decide which twin should carry the hair at each section of the course. At the finish, adjust the two styles to match the requested results.

pages.title: Super Noob Captured Miner
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Dig a tunnel out of prison in Super Noob Captured Miner. Clear earth to open a route for the trapped Noob and look ahead at what lies below before cutting deeper. Guide the character toward freedom through the underground puzzles.

pages.title: Pop Words
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Make words from the letter buttons in Pop Words to burst balloons. Clear them fast enough to descend toward the base ahead of other players, while avoiding sharp obstacles along the way. Check for another valid word as the next set appears.

pages.title: Flying Motorbike Real Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Ride through the streets or take off in Flying Motorbike Real Simulator. Choose a high-tech bike and explore how it handles both on the road and in the air. Move above the city when traffic blocks your ground route.

pages.title: Triadz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Rotate groups of colored shapes in Triadz! to make matches of three or more. Focus on removing pieces from the marked areas while a small opposing board shows another player's progress. Finish the required pattern before your rival.

pages.title: Royal Offense
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: Hire troops and summon heroes to recover a monster-occupied kingdom in Royal Offense. Upgrade the force as you progress through fifteen campaign missions. Try different heroes and difficulty settings as you learn how to handle the enemy types.

pages.title: Safe Circle Space
pages.creator: mzworks
pages.description: Keep a dot moving inside its circular route in Safe Circle Space. Tap to reverse direction when an obstacle approaches and look for another opening as hazards move around it. Stay safe longer to improve your best score.

pages.title: Village Defense
pages.creator: Polar Games
pages.description: Protect a settlement from dinosaurs in Village Defense. Manage food production so you can recruit heroes, then upgrade the two available classes to hold the base. Balance those purchases as you work through ten increasingly demanding stages.

pages.title: Train Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Rebuild railway pictures in Train Jigsaw. Choose a difficulty for each image and earn money from completing the board, with harder layouts giving larger rewards. Save enough to purchase another scene and continue the collection.

pages.title: Red and Green 6 Color Rain
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Control two characters through colorful hazards in Red and Green 6 Color Rain. Gather diamonds and avoid the sharp wheels as you find a route to the next stage. Use the separate keyboard controls or on-screen buttons to guide both characters.

pages.title: Drawing Master
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Identify what an illustration needs and sketch it in Drawing Master. Examine the scene for the absent object or detail, then draw the missing part into place. Try another interpretation when the picture still appears incomplete.

pages.title: Cute Little Dragon Creator
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Build a small fantasy creature in Cute Little Dragon Creator. Change the eyes, wings and tail, choose colors and patterns, and add decorative accessories. Experiment with the options until the dragon has the appearance you want.

pages.title: Bheem Boys
pages.creator: GameTower.io
pages.description: Work with a second player to solve platform puzzles in Bheem Boys. Help the characters through traps, collect all the stars across twenty levels and unlock the boss fight. Coordinate the two players when one needs the other's help to continue.

pages.title: Robots vs Aliens
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Place defensive units against an invasion in Robots vs Aliens. Choose the timing and position of each robot to cover the routes into the base. Use money from destroyed aliens to build more machines and reinforce the defense.

pages.title: Water Sort Puzzle 2
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pour colored liquid between containers in Water Sort Puzzle 2. Separate the layers until each glass holds the right color, using spare capacity to rearrange mixed bottles. Work through three hundred puzzles with more involved sorting layouts.

pages.title: Blackjack Vegas 21
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play a hand against the dealer in Blackjack Vegas 21. Decide whether to hit, stand or double as you compare your total with the visible dealer card. Try to win more chips without taking your hand past twenty-one.

pages.title: Turn Over Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Control a stunt car carrying a stick figure in Turn Over Master. Hold to accelerate or rotate the vehicle through the air, then line it up for the next landing. Adapt the turn to the changing terrain and track.

pages.title: Impostor
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Sabotage a spacecraft and hunt the crew in Impostor. Hide in corners or use vents to approach targets while the others try to survive the voyage. Choose your moment to strike as you work toward eliminating the entire crew.

pages.title: Bob and Chainsaw
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cut timber from either side of the trunk in Bob and Chainsaw. Switch sides before a branch comes down on Bob and keep sawing to build a higher score. Read the next few branches to avoid getting caught as the pace continues.

pages.title: Millionaire Quiz HD
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Enter a trivia game show in Millionaire Quiz HD. Answer questions across subjects such as science, technology, sports and music, then see whether you can reach the top prize. Consider the choices carefully before committing to each answer.

pages.title: Perfect Ironing
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Run an iron over creased clothing in Perfect Ironing. Move across the fabric until the wrinkles are smoothed out, then check for any sections you missed. Work through the levels to leave each garment neatly pressed.

pages.title: Jewelry Shop
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Shop for jewelry and put together a fashion look in Jewelry Shop. Dress the character with the available pieces and enter a beauty contest with your finished style. Try different modes and accessories as you explore the store.

pages.title: Big Farm Match 3
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap fruit and vegetables into groups of at least three in Big Farm Match 3. Check which crops the level needs and direct your matches toward collecting those units. Finish the requested harvest to unlock the next farm board.

pages.title: Dottie Doc McStuffins Cupcake Maker
pages.creator: 6woo.com
pages.description: Make little cakes with a familiar toy doctor in Dottie Doc McStuffins Cupcake Maker. Follow the preparation steps, then choose decorations for the finished cupcakes. Try different details to give each treat a look of its own.

pages.title: Euro Coach Bus City Extreme Driver
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Handle urban driving and parking tasks in Euro Coach Bus City Extreme Driver. Guide the bus around tight spaces and bring it into the marked area. Try challenges set at different times of day and in different seasons.

pages.title: Apple Princess Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Join an expecting princess for a simulated doctor visit in Apple Princess Pregnant Check Up. Measure her belly and follow the prompts for the rest of the checkup. Afterward, help her with fruit, vitamins and music for the baby.

pages.title: Trucks Coloring Book
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose from sixteen vehicle pictures in Trucks Coloring Book and paint one with your favorite shades. Use the palette to fill the bodywork, wheels and scenery, then try another truck when you want a new design.

pages.title: Dog Simulator 3D
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Explore an open world as a pet in Dog Simulator 3D. Form a pack, start a family and improve the dogs' characteristics as you hunt and complete tasks. Visit new areas to find more work for the growing group.

pages.title: Mommy Washing Clothes
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help with laundry in Mommy Washing Clothes. Separate white and colored garments, add the cleaning products and start the wash. Hang everything to dry, then iron and fold the clothes so they are ready to put away.

pages.title: Xtreme 3D Spectacular Monster Truck Offroad Jump
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Race powerful vehicles in Xtreme 3D Spectacular Monster Truck Offroad Jump. Build speed for the rough sections and jumps, then keep the truck balanced when it lands. Challenge the other drivers as you work through the off-road courses.

pages.title: Sniper Attack
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Eliminate targets on two maps in Sniper Attack. Move into position, use the scoped view to pick out an enemy and zoom further when you need a closer look. Keep checking the area for opponents as you clear the map.

pages.title: Block Craft Jumping Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Climb through a block-built world in Block Craft Jumping Adventure. Collect money while jumping higher and avoid enemies on the platforms. Landing on an enemy instead gives extra points and a boost to help you continue upward.

pages.title: Happy Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Color cheerful vehicles in Happy Trucks Coloring. Choose among eight pictures and use the palette of twenty-three colors to fill in the scene. Work quickly if you want a better score, then save the finished artwork.

pages.title: Luxury Wedding Taxi Driver City Limousine Driving
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a long luxury vehicle through city traffic in Luxury Wedding Taxi Driver City Limousine Driving. Pick up the requested passengers and guide the limousine to their destination. Leave enough room through turns to keep the trip under control.

pages.title: Lock Master
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tap to begin opening a lock in Lock Master, then wait until the moving key meets the orange marker. Tap again at the right moment to unlock it and score. Keep your timing accurate as distractions complicate later locks.

pages.title: Glow Hockey HD
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Defend your goal against a computer opponent in Glow Hockey HD. Move the paddle with the mouse and strike the puck toward the far net. Stay ready for the rebound so you can switch back to defense quickly.

pages.title: American Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Paint a truck with a new scheme in American Trucks Coloring. Choose a picture, apply colors and erase an area when you want to redo it. Save the finished image once you have the design you like.

pages.title: Combat Penguin
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Guard a penguin's home in Combat Penguin. Aim at the attacking snowmen and keep firing as they approach the house. Work through successive levels by stopping each group before it can overwhelm your position.

pages.title: Dear Grim Reaper
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Answer questions in Dear Grim Reaper and see the fictional lifespan result the quiz produces. Work through the Halloween-themed screens, then try a different set of answers to compare what the game tells you.

pages.title: Extreme Pixel Gun Apocalypse 3
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Enter online firefights in Extreme Pixel Gun Apocalypse 3. Move your pixel character through different 3D maps and use the available weapons against other players. Watch the approaches around your position as you look for a clear shot.

pages.title: FG Plumber2
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Connect pipes to drain rising water in FG Plumber2. Trace the route from the leak and turn the pieces so they meet in the correct direction. Complete the channel before the increasing water level overtakes your work.

pages.title: Air Combat
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shoot down hostile aircraft in Air Combat. Collect dropped weapons, fuel and health while steering around enemy attacks. Keep the plane supplied as you clear the next group from the sky.

pages.title: Flap Up 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Tap to send your character upward in Flap Up 2. Watch the moving obstacles on either side and time each rise to stay clear of them. Pick up coins as you climb and keep going for a better score.

pages.title: Super Chick Duck
pages.creator: Lunar
pages.description: Choose a chicken or a duck in Super Chick Duck and ride a skateboard through an endless course. Jump over gaps and hazards while keeping the character moving forward. See which bird you can carry to the better score.

pages.title: Desert Driving
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Drive through fifteen desert courses in Desert Driving. Adjust to the slopes without crashing and collect coins and stars along the way. Use what you earn to unlock more cars, trucks and motorcycles for later stages.

pages.title: Fashion Presentation
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare several girls for a runway appearance in Fashion Presentation. Pick clothing from the available wardrobes and build an outfit for each model. Coordinate the pieces so they are ready to show their finished looks.

pages.title: Swipe Car
pages.creator: Dreamly Games
pages.description: Swipe left or right to weave through traffic in Swipe Car. Try different vehicles on snowy, desert and forest roads while keeping clear of the cars around you. Read the gaps ahead before moving into another lane.

pages.title: Christmas Panda Run
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Guide a panda through a snowy route in Christmas Panda Run. Jump obstacles and watch for hostile creatures and snowmen along the path. Keep the panda alive as you work through the holiday platforming course.

pages.title: Dunes
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Build speed down slopes and soar over the scoring line in Dunes. Hold to accelerate, release to fly and tap to manage the landing. Watch the angle on the way down, since higher jumps make a smooth return harder.

pages.title: Sky Invasion
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pilot a spacecraft against an alien force in Sky Invasion. Move with the keyboard or mouse and shoot the enemies that cross your path. Work through the battle while steering away from attacks that can end the flight.

pages.title: Car model dress up
pages.creator: DUGS
pages.description: Style a model for a motor show in Car model dress up. Try the available clothes and accessories and see how the pieces work together beside the car. Finish an outfit suited to her appearance at the event.

pages.title: Snail Bob 7
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide a dreaming snail through a fantasy world in Snail Bob 7. Click Bob to stop or start him while working the surrounding mechanisms, then change his direction or pace through the controls. Watch for dragons, knights and other obstacles along the route.

pages.title: Princess Annie  Summer Wedding
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a bride for the weekend ceremony in Princess Annie Summer Wedding. Choose Annie's makeup first, then find a gown and accessories to complete her look. Help her get ready for the celebration with Kristof.

pages.title: Morning catch
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Choose a fishing spot and cast your bait in Morning catch. Wait for a bite, then reel in the fish when the action starts. Try for different species and use the rewards from catches to improve your fishing equipment.

pages.title: Adam and Eve: Love Quest
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a prehistoric traveler search for a love potion in Adam and Eve: Love Quest. Inspect the creatures and objects in each scene to find the action that clears the route. Follow the chain of puzzles toward the treasure.

pages.title: Invaders Combat EG
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Fight waves of spacecraft in Invaders Combat. Move through the arcade battlefield and fire at the incoming formation while avoiding return shots. Keep clearing enemies as the simple opening waves give way to more demanding attacks.

pages.title: Ferrari Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reconstruct a sports-car picture in Ferrari Jigsaw. Drag the pieces into their correct places and use the car's shape to work out the order. Keep fitting the smaller details together until the image is complete.

pages.title: Cloud Critters
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Keep an animal character aloft in Cloud Critters. Jump and dodge through the sky as hazards interrupt the route. Choose a critter and try to survive longer as you get used to timing its movement.

pages.title: Salazar the Alchemist
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Combine three or more equal elements in Salazar the Alchemist to discover the next material. Build the chain of creations toward a mysterious artifact, earning coins as you merge. Spend them on boosters when they help unlock another discovery.

pages.title: Taco Bar
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Prepare Mexican food for waiting customers in Taco Bar. Check each request and choose the ingredients needed for the order. Serve the completed tacos and keep the kitchen moving as another customer arrives.

pages.title: Cube Xtreme
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Jump a moving block through twenty-seven stages in Cube Xtreme. Watch for spikes and traps before each leap and head toward the flag at the end. Try both modes as you learn the platforming routes.

pages.title: Tris Date Night Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open mystery boxes to choose an outfit in Tris Date Night Dolly Dress Up H5. Mix the tops, bottoms, hairstyles and sparkling accessories you uncover. Take a picture of the finished look once Tris is ready to meet her boyfriend.
